# Regulatory Compliance and AML Strategy 2026 Update

This memo details critical actions required for the upcoming strategy period:

*   Investigate the latest regulatory changes and standard updates.
*   Update the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection systems for Strategy 2026.
*   Optimize internal control standards.
*   Optimize management of legal risks for Strategy 2026.
*   Review the effectiveness of AML detection mechanisms for Strategy 2026.
